description: Take a grid span apart. Tile posts that have not gone out move to the trash (kept 30 days; undo restores them); tiles already posted stay as ordinary posts. The set is gone afterward, so a second call finds nothing. The layout post and its layout are not touched: make a new set from it with stills_set_create. The grid crop figure is unmeasured, so this stays off until the owner measures it with a test post on a real profile.

confirm_token.description: Token from a CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED response, sent after the user confirms.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: stills_set_remove
title: Remove the span
